simple.summary: אֶלְחָנָן (ʼElchânân) means Elchanan , an Israelite First listed occurrence: 1Chr 11 26.

definitions.full: H445. Elchanan אֶלְחָנָן proper name, masculine ( God has been gracious , compare Phoenician בעלחנן אלחנן, , in Assyrian Ba'al—anunu COT Gen 10:18 ) two of David's chiefs 2Sam 21:19 = 1Chr 20:5 ; 2Sam 23:24 = 1Chr 11:26 .
